column1: # user_args_table.tsv —— T113：`graphwar_root_node::Args` 的 5 条命令行参数（真二进制实测）
# 复算：见 docs/06 §157 与 fixtures/denom_rest2_plan.txt §1/P3
# 口径：arm64 = Android 2.0.60 未 strip 版（.reference/steam/android-2.0.60/libgraphwarrust.so，地址 = ELF vaddr）
#   slot_* = 该串在 .rodata 的槽地址；len_* = 该槽的字节长度（从调用点的 (ptr,len) 实参直接读出）
#   类型依据：`_<u16 as clap_builder::builder::value_parser::ValueParserFactory>::value_parser` 在
#   augment_args 里出现 3 次（arm64 0x3b1178 / 0x3b1518 / 0x3b1890）；String 的 Arg::value_parser 单态 2 次
#   required 依据：from_arg_matches_mut（0x3b2250）里 5 次 try_remove_one 的长度 = 14/14/11/11/20，
#   之后 2 次 clap_builder::error::Error::raw（长度 64 / 61 = "The following required argument was not
#   provided: broadcast_port" / 同句 + "logger_port") ⇒ 只有这两个必填，其余是 Option<..>
# 证据档：观测（id/long/value_name/help/类型/必填都有指令或槽）；value_name 与参数的**逐条配对**是推断
#   （5 次 Arg::value_names + 5 条大写串，命名与 id 一一对应，但没有把每次调的实参逐个配对）
id
broker_address
column15: Address of the broker server to connect (e.g. 127.0.0.1:42970). If not specified, the address is fetched from https://graphwar.com/graphwar_II_ip.txt

column1: broadcast_port
column15: Port used for LAN game discovery broadcasts

column1: logger_port
column15: Port used for the debug logger

column1: server_port
column15: Port the game server listens on when hosting a game. If not specified, the OS picks a free port

column1: crash_report_address
column15: Address of the crash report collector server (e.g. 127.0.0.1:42972). If not specified, the game's global server address is reused with CRASH_REPORT_PORT
